quote: Diana was the goddess of childbirth, the fertility goddess, the goddess of the moon as well as the patron goddess of wild beasts in Roman mythology.

statement.id: Diana adalah dewi Romawi yang berkaitan dengan kelahiran, kesuburan, bulan, dan hewan liar.
statement.en: Diana was a Roman goddess associated with childbirth, fertility, the moon, and wild animals.

quote: However, she is best known as the goddess of the hunt, with her sacred animal being the deer.

statement.id: Diana paling dikenal sebagai dewi perburuan dengan rusa sebagai hewan sucinya.
statement.en: Diana is best known as a hunt goddess, with the deer as her sacred animal.

quote: Her equivalent in Greek mythology is Artemis.

statement.id: Diana disamakan dengan Artemis dalam mitologi Yunani.
statement.en: Diana was identified with the Greek Artemis.

quote: Diana was the daughter of Jupiter and Latona (the Roman equivalent of Leto), the goddess of dark nights.

statement.id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, dalam silsilah Romawi Diana adalah putri Jupiter dan Latona.
statement.en: According to World History Encyclopedia, in Roman genealogy Diana is the daughter of Jupiter and Latona.

quote: he sent a dolphin to carry Latona to the island of Delos where she gave birth to Apollo and Diana.

statement.id: Diana dan Apollo dikisahkan lahir di Pulau Delos.
statement.en: Diana and Apollo were said to be born on Delos.

quote: In most works of Roman art, Diana is depicted armed with a bow and quiver of arrows

statement.id: Seni Romawi sering menggambarkan Diana membawa busur dan tabung panah.
statement.en: Roman art commonly portrays Diana with a bow and quiver.

quote: One of the best-known myths of Diana is that of Actaeon.

statement.id: Actaeon adalah tokoh dalam salah satu kisah Diana yang paling dikenal.
statement.en: Actaeon appears in one of Diana's best-known stories.

quote: he grew the horns of a stag, his hands became feet and his arms were changed into legs.

statement.id: Dalam kisah Actaeon, ia tumbuh tanduk rusa jantan, tangannya menjadi kaki, dan lengannya berubah menjadi tungkai.
statement.en: In the Actaeon story he grows the horns of a stag, his hands become feet and his arms are changed into legs.

quote: The most important sanctuary of Diana for the ancient Romans was located at Aricia, some eleven miles outside of Rome on the shore of lake Nemi

statement.id: Tempat suci Diana yang penting bagi orang Romawi terletak di Aricia dekat Danau Nemi.
statement.en: An important Roman sanctuary of Diana stood at Aricia by Lake Nemi.

quote: Artemis, known to the Romans as Diana, stands with her weight on her right leg, her left foot trailing.

statement.id: Patung perunggu yang dicatat The Met menampilkan Artemis yang disebut Diana oleh orang Romawi.
statement.en: A Met bronze statue depicts Artemis, known to Romans as Diana.

quote: according to most accounts, her skill with the bow unquestionably equaled that of her twin brother Apollo.

statement.id: Menurut sebagian besar riwayat, keterampilan Diana memanah setara dengan saudara kembarnya, Apollo.
statement.en: According to most accounts, Diana's skill with the bow equaled that of her twin brother Apollo.

quote: Latona was enraged and told Apollo and Diana to kill all 14 of Niobe's children.

statement.id: Dalam kisah Niobe, Latona yang murka menyuruh Apollo dan Diana membunuh keempat belas anak Niobe.
statement.en: In the Niobe story, an enraged Latona told Apollo and Diana to kill all 14 of Niobe's children.

quote: Choosing never to marry, Diana received permission from her father to remain a virgin, joining Vesta and Minerva as the only virgin goddesses.

statement.id: Diana memilih tidak menikah dan mendapat izin dari ayahnya untuk tetap perawan, bergabung dengan Vesta dan Minerva sebagai satu-satunya dewi perawan.
statement.en: Choosing never to marry, Diana received her father's permission to remain a virgin, joining Vesta and Minerva as the only virgin goddesses.

quote: Fearing that his beauty might be marred by toil and exposure, Diana caused him to fall into an eternal sleep.

statement.id: Dalam kisah Endymion, Diana membuat pemuda itu tertidur abadi karena takut kecantikannya rusak oleh kerja keras dan cuaca.
statement.en: In the Endymion story, Diana caused the youth to fall into an eternal sleep, fearing his beauty might be marred by toil and exposure.

quote: Diana, of course, hit it, but the target turned out to be Orion out for a nightly swim. In her grief, she turned Orion and Sirius into a constellation.

statement.id: Dalam kisah Orion, Diana mengenai sasaran yang ternyata adalah Orion yang sedang berenang malam, lalu dalam dukanya ia mengubah Orion dan Sirius menjadi rasi bintang.
statement.en: In the Orion story, Diana hit a target that turned out to be Orion swimming at night, and in her grief turned Orion and Sirius into a constellation.

quote: the nymphs could go no further and asked Diana for help. She turned them into pigeons.

statement.id: Ketika para nimfa memohon bantuan, Diana mengubah mereka menjadi merpati.
statement.en: When the nymphs asked Diana for help, she turned them into pigeons.

quote: Diana, angry at his impudence, stilled the waters, preventing the Greek ships from sailing.

statement.id: Dalam kisah Perang Troya, Diana yang marah menenangkan perairan sehingga kapal-kapal Yunani tidak dapat berlayar.
statement.en: In the Trojan War story, an angered Diana stilled the waters so that the Greek ships could not sail.

quote: but Diana intervened, replacing her with a deer. She would become a priestess at Diana's temple.

statement.id: Ketika Iphigenia hendak dikurbankan, Diana turun tangan dan menggantikannya dengan seekor rusa; Iphigenia kemudian menjadi pendeta di kuil Diana.
statement.en: When Iphigenia was about to be sacrificed, Diana intervened and replaced her with a deer; she later became a priestess at Diana's temple.

quote: Diana is heartbroken, for Camilla was a favorite of hers.

statement.id: Dalam Aeneid, Diana berduka atas kematian Camilla, yang menjadi kesayangannya.
statement.en: In the Aeneid, Diana is heartbroken at the death of Camilla, a favorite of hers.

quote: DIANA, in Roman mythology, an old Italian goddess, in later times identified with the Greek Artemis

statement.id: Menurut Britannica 1911, Diana dalam mitologi Romawi adalah dewi Italia kuno yang pada masa kemudian disamakan dengan Artemis Yunani.
statement.en: According to the 1911 Britannica, in Roman mythology Diana is an old Italian goddess, in later times identified with the Greek Artemis.

quote: That she was originally an independent Italian deity is shown by her name, which is the feminine form of Janus (= Dianus).

statement.id: Namanya, bentuk feminin dari Janus (Dianus), menunjukkan bahwa ia semula dewi Italia yang berdiri sendiri.
statement.en: Her name, the feminine form of Janus (Dianus), shows she was originally an independent Italian deity.

quote: She is essentially the goddess of the moon and light generally, and presides over wood, plain and water, the chase and war.

statement.id: Menurut Britannica 1911, Diana pada dasarnya dewi bulan dan cahaya, yang menguasai hutan, dataran, air, perburuan, dan perang.
statement.en: According to the 1911 Britannica, Diana is essentially the goddess of the moon and light generally, presiding over wood, plain and water, the chase and war.

quote: As the goddess of childbirth, she was known, like Juno, by the name of Lucina, the “bringer to light.”

statement.id: Sebagai dewi kelahiran, Diana dikenal dengan nama Lucina, "pembawa ke cahaya", seperti Juno.
statement.en: As goddess of childbirth Diana was known, like Juno, as Lucina, the "bringer to light".

quote: As the moon-goddess she was also identified with Hecate, and invoked as “three-formed” in reference to the phases of the moon.

statement.id: Sebagai dewi bulan, Diana juga disamakan dengan Hecate dan dipanggil "berwujud tiga" merujuk pada fase bulan.
statement.en: As moon-goddess Diana was also identified with Hecate and invoked as "three-formed" in reference to the phases of the moon.

quote: Her most celebrated shrine was in a grove at Aricia (whence her title of Nemorensis) near the modern lake of Nemi. Here she was worshipped side by side with a male deity Virbius, a god of the forest and the chase.

statement.id: Tempat sucinya yang paling termasyhur ada di hutan kecil di Aricia dekat Danau Nemi (maka gelar Nemorensis); di sana ia dipuja bersama dewa Virbius, dewa hutan dan perburuan.
statement.en: Her most celebrated shrine was in a grove at Aricia near Lake Nemi (hence her title Nemorensis), where she was worshipped alongside Virbius, a god of the forest and the chase.

quote: her priest, called Rex Nemorensis, who was a runaway slave, was obliged to qualify for office by slaying his predecessor in single combat

statement.id: Pendeta Diana di Aricia, disebut Rex Nemorensis, adalah budak pelarian yang harus membunuh pendahulunya dalam duel untuk memenuhi syarat jabatan.
statement.en: Diana's priest at Aricia, called Rex Nemorensis, was a runaway slave obliged to qualify for office by slaying his predecessor in single combat.

quote: The worship of Diana was brought to Rome by Latin plebeians, and hence she was regarded as the protectress of the lower classes, and especially of slaves.

statement.id: Pemujaan Diana dibawa ke Roma oleh kaum plebeian Latin, sehingga ia dipandang sebagai pelindung kelas bawah dan terutama budak.
statement.en: The worship of Diana was brought to Rome by Latin plebeians, so she was regarded as protectress of the lower classes and especially of slaves.

quote: her most important temple was that on the Aventine, the chief seat of the plebeians, founded by Servius Tullius, originally as a sanctuary of the Latin league

statement.id: Kuil terpenting Diana di Roma berada di Aventine, pusat kaum plebeian, didirikan oleh Servius Tullius semula sebagai tempat suci liga Latin.
statement.en: Diana's most important temple at Rome was on the Aventine, chief seat of the plebeians, founded by Servius Tullius originally as a sanctuary of the Latin league.

quote: No man was allowed to enter the temple, and on the day of its dedication (August 13) the slaves kept holiday

statement.id: Laki-laki dilarang memasuki kuil itu, dan pada hari penahbisannya (13 Agustus) para budak berlibur.
statement.en: No man was allowed to enter the temple, and on its dedication day (August 13) the slaves kept holiday.

quote: The festival of the goddess was on the ides (13th) of August, the full moon of the hot season. She was worshipped with torches, her aid was sought by women seeking a happy deliverance in childbirth, and many votive offerings have been found on the site.

statement.id: Pesta Diana jatuh pada idus (13) Agustus; ia dipuja dengan obor, dan kaum perempuan memohon bantuannya untuk persalinan yang selamat.
statement.en: The goddess's festival was on the ides (13th) of August; she was worshipped with torches, and women sought her aid for a happy delivery in childbirth.

quote: As Noctiluca (“giving light by night”) she had a sanctuary on the Palatine which was kept illuminated throughout the night

statement.id: Sebagai Noctiluca, "pemberi cahaya di malam hari", Diana memiliki tempat suci di Palatine yang diterangi sepanjang malam.
statement.en: As Noctiluca, "giving light by night", Diana had a sanctuary on the Palatine kept illuminated all night.

quote: Another celebrated sanctuary of Diana was that on the slopes of Mount Tifata near Capua (where she was worshipped under the name of Tifatina)

statement.id: Tempat suci Diana lain yang termasyhur berada di lereng Gunung Tifata dekat Capua, tempat ia dipuja dengan nama Tifatina.
statement.en: Another celebrated sanctuary of Diana was on the slopes of Mount Tifata near Capua, where she was worshipped as Tifatina.

quote: There is a valley called Gargaphia; sacred to Diana, dense with pine trees and the pointed cypress

statement.id: Dalam Metamorphoses Ovid, lembah Gargaphia disebut keramat bagi Diana dan lebat oleh pohon pinus dan cemara runcing.
statement.en: In Ovid's Metamorphoses the valley of Gargaphia is sacred to Diana, dense with pine trees and pointed cypress.

quote: Here, when a-wearied with exciting sport, the Sylvan goddess loved to come and bathe her virgin beauty in the crystal pool.

statement.id: Menurut Ovid, di lembah itu Diana, sang dewi hutan, gemar mandi di kolam jernih setelah lelah berburu.
statement.en: In Ovid, Diana, the Sylvan goddess, loved to bathe in the crystal pool of that valley when wearied with sport.

quote: Oh, how she wished her arrows were at hand! But only having water, this she took and dashed it on his manly countenance

statement.id: Dalam kisah Actaeon menurut Ovid, Diana berharap panahnya ada di tangan, tetapi hanya memiliki air yang ia percikkan ke wajah pemuda itu.
statement.en: In Ovid's Actaeon story, Diana wished her arrows were at hand but, having only water, dashed it on the young man's face.

quote: No more she threatened, but she fixed the horns of a great stag firm on his sprinkled brows; she lengthened out his neck; she made his ears sharp at the top; she changed his hands and feet;

statement.id: Menurut Ovid, Diana memasang tanduk rusa jantan besar pada dahi Actaeon, memanjangkan lehernya, meruncingkan telinganya, dan mengubah tangan serta kakinya.
statement.en: In Ovid, Diana fixed a great stag's horns on Actaeon's brows, lengthened his neck, made his ears sharp, and changed his hands and feet.

quote: 'Tis said Diana's fury raged with none abatement till the torn flesh ceased to live.

statement.id: Menurut Ovid, kemurkaan Diana tidak mereda sampai daging Actaeon yang tercabik berhenti hidup.
statement.en: In Ovid it is said that Diana's fury did not abate until the torn flesh ceased to live.

quote: Go tell it, if your tongue can tell the tale, your bold eyes saw me stripped of all my robes.

statement.id: Dalam Ovid, Diana berkata kepada Actaeon agar menceritakan, bila lidahnya mampu, bahwa matanya telah melihatnya tanpa busana.
statement.en: In Ovid, Diana tells Actaeon to tell, if his tongue can, that his bold eyes saw her stripped of all her robes.

quote: And while they bathed Diana in their streams, Actaeon, wandering through the unknown woods, entered the precincts of that sacred grove;

statement.id: Menurut Ovid, ketika para nimfa memandikan Diana, Actaeon yang mengembara di hutan tak dikenal memasuki hutan keramat itu.
statement.en: In Ovid, while the nymphs bathed Diana, Actaeon, wandering through unknown woods, entered the precincts of that sacred grove.
